event_text: Malicious requests hit Wellington IT's CU Online platform: about 1.4 million per the league, about five million per Wellington's correspondence (Irish Examiner)
notes: Whole days, Irish time. The Irish Times gives Oct 6 for the exploit.
Date from the league; the department says only that it is closed.

event_text: Wellington IT detects a possible breach, per the league
Wellington IT emails affected credit unions
notes: The Irish Times says the email went out Monday.

event_text: The Department of Finance first becomes aware of the incident
North East Credit Union posts a notice to members listing the payee fields potentially accessed
The Department of Finance meets Wellington IT and the credit union sector and publishes a statement
Three credit union bodies issue a joint statement calling for the number of affected members
